# THE MEASUREMENT Base14Widths11.m's table is generated from.  Committed rather than left in a run
# directory, because `make-base14-table.lua --check` reads it and a check that cannot run from a clean
# checkout is not a check.
#
# It is the verbatim output of tools/host-base14.m over the base-fourteen fixtures, in this order:
#
#   $ xmake l tools/make-font-fixtures.lua <a cgfixture-1.pdf written by make-text-fixture> <fixtures dir>
#   $ clang -fobjc-arc -Wall -Werror=incomplete-implementation tools/host-base14.m \
#       -framework Foundation -framework PDFKit -framework CoreGraphics -o host-base14
#   $ ./host-base14 <fixtures>/cgfixture-base14-*-0.pdf <fixtures>/cgfixture-base14-*-1.pdf \
#       <fixtures>/cgfixture-base14-*-space.pdf <fixtures>/cgfixture-base14-*-descent.pdf
#
# on this Mac, 2026-10-03.  Every line below the header is that run's output, unchanged: the
# per-character advances (a `w=` per code) and the `-space` and `-descent` fixtures' whole-line rects the
# generator derives the space and each face's descent from.  A `#` line is not data - the reader matches
# the shapes above it and ignores these.
#
# Measured, not transcribed: the run reproduces Helvetica's and Courier's published widths and CORRECTS
# two published numbers (Courier's descent is -246 where the AFM says -157; Times-Roman's `t` is 278
# where a table says 333).  See packages/a/apple-backports/facts/PDFKit/Selection11.md.
